links.outcome: Binary specialty-referral classification versus fine-grained pathway assignment on synthetic vignettes
links.effect: Binary referral F1 0.85-1.00 with recall 1.00 ± 0.00 across domains; multi-class pathway F1 was headache 0.47, lower back pain 0.72, prostate cancer 0.77.
links.quote: The binary specialty referral classification achieved consistently strong performance across all domains (F1: 0.85-1.00), with high recall (1.00 $\pm$ 0.00).

unlisted_practices: Converting narrative clinical guidelines into structured decision trees that an LLM navigates for patient case evaluation

screen.reason: Evaluates a novel auto-prompting framework (CPGPrompt) that translates clinical guidelines into LLM prompts using synthetic patient vignettes, focusing on system performance/accuracy without testing a deployment safeguard.
